what: Number of cash deposits in the last 30 days
motivation: Launderers place cash in many small deposits
if_higher: Many deposits: check amounts and branches; normal for cash businesses
if_lower: Few: normal for most retail customers

what: Cash deposited in 30 days divided by the customer's declared monthly income
motivation: Cash far beyond declared income is hard to explain
if_higher: Well above 0.5: more cash than the declared income explains

what: Share of cash deposits between 9,000 and 9,999 USD, just under the reporting threshold
motivation: Deposits that cluster just below 10,000 USD avoid currency transaction reports
if_higher: Above 0.2: deposits are being kept under the threshold

what: Distinct branches where cash was deposited in the last 30 days
motivation: Spreading deposits across branches avoids attention
if_higher: 3 or more: deposits spread across branches

what: Money received in the last 30 days divided by the 12-month monthly average
motivation: Laundering often shows up as a sudden step in volume
if_higher: Above 2: far more money than usual is arriving

what: Money sent in the last 30 days divided by the 12-month monthly average
motivation: Funds moving out faster than usual
if_higher: Above 2: far more money than usual is leaving

what: Share of the month's inflow still in the account at month end
motivation: Mule accounts are pipes: money leaves as fast as it arrives
if_higher: Above 0.5: the customer keeps money; lower risk
if_lower: Near 0: almost nothing stays; classic pass-through (also seen in payroll and gig accounts)

what: Median hours between money arriving and leaving
motivation: Laundered funds are moved on within hours to break the trail
if_higher: Long: money sits; normal saving
if_lower: A few hours: funds are moved on almost immediately

what: Distinct people or companies that sent money in the last 30 days
motivation: Mules collect from many victims or other mules
if_higher: Above 8: many senders; normal for gig workers

what: Distinct people or companies that received money in the last 30 days
motivation: Layering spreads funds across many receivers
if_higher: Many receivers: check whether it is payroll

what: Share of this month's counterparties never seen before on the account
motivation: Mules deal with strangers; real customers have repeat payees
if_higher: Above 0.5: mostly strangers

what: Share of incoming money from person-to-person payment apps
motivation: Mule recruiters often route victim funds through P2P apps
if_higher: High: mostly P2P money; normal for gig workers

what: Share of outgoing wires sent to high-risk jurisdictions
motivation: Weak-control jurisdictions are where funds get lost
if_higher: Above 0.3: much of the money goes to high-risk places; check for family remittances

what: Share of payments in round amounts (multiples of 1,000 USD)
motivation: Real commerce rarely comes in round thousands
if_higher: Above 0.4: many round-number payments

what: Months with any activity in the last 12
motivation: A long-quiet account that suddenly moves money may have been sold or borrowed
if_higher: 11 to 12: steadily used
if_lower: 1 to 3: the account was dormant for most of the year (also seasonal businesses)

what: This month's transaction count divided by the 12-month monthly average
motivation: A sudden step in activity
if_higher: Above 3: a burst of activity

what: Days since the account was opened
motivation: Mule accounts are often opened recently and used quickly
if_higher: Years: established
if_lower: Under a few months: a new account

what: Other accounts that logged in from the same device, plus one
motivation: One person running several accounts
if_higher: 2 or more: a shared device

what: Share of outgoing money withdrawn as cash
motivation: Cash exits break the trail
if_higher: High: money leaves as cash

what: Average transaction amount in the last 30 days, USD
motivation: Context for volume features
if_higher: High: larger transactions; normal for businesses

what: Transactions in the last 30 days
motivation: Context; busy accounts generate more of everything
if_higher: High: a busy account

what: International wires sent in the last 30 days
motivation: Cross-border wires are a main laundering channel
if_higher: 2 or more: regular international wires; check the destinations

what: Share of transactions between 00:00 and 05:00
motivation: Kept as a control
if_higher: High: night owl or automation

what: Declared income band at onboarding, 1 (lowest) to 5 (highest)
motivation: Activity is judged against what the customer said they earn
if_higher: 5: high declared income
